en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a wide waterfront street with tram tracks running along the center. On the right side are numerous sailing ships moored at the quay, their masts forming a dense forest of lines. On the left side stand multi‑story buildings with shops and pedestrians. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and the quay. Printed captions in French and English identify the scene as the quays/the wharfs of Salonique.
